sentence_stem: Although the article was very long,
full_sentence: Although the article was very long, most readers finished it.
acceptable_variants: many people still read it to the end.

options.text: so most readers stopped after one page.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, but 'although' requires a contrast, not a consequence.

options.text: the writer added three more pages.
options.why_wrong: This adds information about length but does not show the contrast that 'although' requires.

options.text: it had no headings at all.
options.why_wrong: This describes the article but does not give the contrasting outcome that 'although' expects.

explanation: After 'although', the second clause must show contrast with the first part of the sentence. Learners often confuse concessive clauses with cause-and-effect clauses, so check whether the sentence expects a surprising outcome or a logical result.
translation: Embora o artigo fosse muito longo, a maioria dos leitores o terminou.
